intermediate.name: San José de la Rinconada
intermediate.title: Sprint | San José de la Rinconada (165 km)

story: Enzo Paleni and Sinuhé Fernandez launched an early attack in Stage 17 of La Vuelta 2026, gaining a 5-minute lead. Paleni broke away solo with 15km to go but was caught 3km before the finish. Brennan secured an easy fifth stage win ahead of Meeus and Cort.
